blurb: Deep Creek Golf Club offers a 6,000-yard golf course designed by Mark McCumber, blending natural beauty with strategic challenges. The club features a warm-up driving range, putting green, short game area, and a lounge with a grill room. It is open daily from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM and requires proper golf attire.
